title: [Chapitre] IV. Analysis situs (première mouture) : notes manuscrites (10/06/1986).

deep.reconstruction:
Context: this is Grothendieck's 1986 'Analysis situs' draft, which tries to axiomatise tame stratified spaces combinatorially. The data are a set of 'elementary figures' Fél, partially ordered by ≤. Think of an elementary figure as the closure of a connected stratum, ordered by inclusion. Inside Fél there is a family R of 'configurations', meaning mutually compatible subsets. 'Figures' are configurations that are downward closed (and locally finite). Axiom Fig_1, on the previous page, says that for each X the set {X' ≤ X} is a configuration, and hence a figure.

Axiom Fig_2 (this page). For each X in Fél, the ordered set {X' ≤ X} has finite combinatorial dimension. That is, there is an integer n such that every finite totally ordered subset (chain) bounded above by X has cardinality at most n.

Definition 1. The combinatorial dimension of X is the supremum of the cardinalities of such chains, minus 1. In modern terms this is the height (rank) of X in the poset, i.e. the length of the longest chain below X.
- Consequently the dimension is always ≥ 0.
- It equals 0 if and only if X is a minimal element of Fél.

Interpretation in the model examples (stratified spaces). The minimal elementary figures are the closed connected pieces that are manifolds, i.e. closed strata with no smaller strata in their closure. So combinatorial dimension is not geometric dimension: it measures the depth of the stratification, i.e. how many strata are nested below.

Definition 2. For a figure L ⊂ Fél (a downward-closed configuration), comb dim L is defined in the same way, equivalently as sup{comb dim X : X ∈ L}. For L = ∅ this is −1 or −∞.

Claim. comb dim L = 0 if and only if L ≠ ∅ and the induced order relation on L is discrete. Equivalently (next page), L consists of minimal elements. By the next page, such figures correspond to nonempty closed submanifolds with trivial stratification, whose connected components are the elements.

Purpose: this sets up a combinatorial (Krull-type) dimension as a dévissage invariant for the theory of stratified 'figures'. It supports induction on depth, in the spirit of the tame-topology programme of the Esquisse.
errors: No real errors. The equivalence 'dim 0 iff minimal' needs chains of length 1 to be the only ones below X, which holds by definition. Downward closure of figures is what makes 'comb dim L = 0 iff L consists of minimal elements' work.
The empty figure's dimension (−1 or −∞) is left implicit; that is why the condition L ≠ ∅ appears.
Calling the minimal figures 'variétés connexes' is accurate only for genuinely stratified models where closed strata are manifolds. In general it is a heuristic.

ideas.what: Combinatorial dimension of an elementary figure as the height of the poset of elementary figures below it (sup of chain cardinalities minus 1), assumed finite (axiom Fig_2)
ideas.modern_name: poset height/rank; Krull-type dimension; depth of a stratum in a stratification poset
ideas.usually_credited_to: Standard order theory / Krull. Depth of strata in stratified spaces appears e.g. in Ayala–Francis–Tanaka and in Lurie's Higher Algebra (appendix A)
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme §5–6 discusses tame topology and dévissage of stratified structures, but not, to my knowledge, this explicit combinatorial dimension

ideas.what: Distinction between combinatorial dimension (depth in the strata poset) and geometric dimension: minimal elements are closed connected manifold pieces of arbitrary dimension
ideas.modern_name: depth vs dimension of a stratified space
ideas.usually_credited_to: Stratification theory (Whitney, Thom, Mather); depth used systematically by Ayala–Francis–Tanaka

ideas.what: Figures of combinatorial dimension 0 are the nonempty discrete (antichain) downward-closed configurations, corresponding to closed submanifolds with trivial stratification
ideas.modern_name: antichains of minimal elements / unstratified closed submanifolds

missed.claim: This page is part of an unpublished poset-theoretic axiomatisation of stratified 'figures' (elementary figures, configurations, figures as down-closed configurations). Its finiteness-of-depth axiom anticipates later poset-stratified frameworks (exit-path/stratification posets). The specific content here, however, is routine.
missed.quote: La dimension combinatoire d'un X ∈ Fél est le sup des cardinaux des parties finies précédentes, diminués de 1.
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: Documents Grothendieck's combinatorial approach to tame topology via posets of closed strata. This is of historical interest relative to modern poset-stratified spaces, but brings no new mathematics on this page.

deep.surprise_reason: Defines combinatorial dimension as poset height and characterises dimension 0. This is standard order theory applied to his unpublished axiomatics of stratified figures; it is interesting only as part of the larger unpublished Analysis situs framework.
transcription_corrections: Line 2: the label is likely 'Fig_2' (the axiom following Fig_1 on the previous page). The insertion read as 'un ordinal des' is more plausibly 'l'ens ordonné des X' ≤ X'.
The inserted phrase 'chaînes totalement ordonnées' replaces or qualifies 'parties finies'. Read: 'les parties finies totalement ordonnées majorées par X sont de cardinal ≤ n'.
Last line: 'la valuation' should almost certainly be 'la relation [d'ordre induite sur L est discrète]', continued on the next page as 'est discrète'.
'Dans les exemples types' (not 'types' alone). 'correspondent aux parties fermées de X qui sont des variétés connexes' is consistent with the image.
